set_translations (table)
- id: INTEGER NOT NULL
- language: TEXT
- setCode: TEXT
- translation: TEXT
PRIMARY KEY (id)
FOREIGN KEY (setCode) REFERENCES sets (code)

arguments.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS releases,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN TRIM(t.translation) <> '' AND TRIM(t.language) <> '' THEN s.id END) AS translated_sets,
       COUNT(t.id) AS translation_rows,
       COUNT(t.translation) AS populated_names,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN TRIM(t.translation) = '' THEN 1 END) AS blank_names,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.language) AS languages
FROM main.sets AS s
LEFT JOIN main.set_translations AS t ON t.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2016-01-01' AND s.releaseDate < '2017-01-01'

arguments.sql:
WITH per_set AS (
    SELECT s.id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.language) AS language_count
    FROM main.sets AS s
    LEFT JOIN main.set_translations AS t
        ON t.setCode = s.code
       AND TRIM(t.translation) <> ''
       AND TRIM(t.language) <> ''
    WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2016-01-01'
      AND s.releaseDate < '2017-01-01'
    GROUP BY s.id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(language_count), 2) AS average_languages
FROM per_set
LIMIT 1
